name: Fire Cloak Ballroom
description: An enchanted ballroom in a crystal pavilion where dancers wear flowing cloaks of living flame that shift colors, creating a mesmerizing display of fire and movement against a glass backdrop.
prompt: An elegant glass pavilion ballroom where dancers wear flowing cloaks made of living flame that shift through colors of gold, blue, red, and purple. The fire cloaks create mesmerizing trails of light as dancers move gracefully. Crystal walls and ceilings refract the firelight into rainbow patterns. Dramatic lighting, elegant atmosphere, ultra-detailed, 8k
caption: Dancing with fire has never been this elegant! 🔥💃✨ In this crystal palace, every dancer carries liquid light that flows and swirls with each movement. The fire doesn't burn—it beautifies, painting the air with trails of gold and crimson. If you could dance with any element, which would you choose?
